blocks.text: Debugging software mein bugs ya errors (ghaltiyan) dhoondne aur theek karne ka process hai. Software debugging aur testing software development ke zaroori hisse hain. Yeh yaqeeni banate hain ke software theek kaam kare aur user ki requirements poori kare.

Bugs software ki woh ghaltiyan hain jin ki wajah se software unexpected (achanak, jaisa nahi chahiye) tareeqe se chalta hai. Bug pehchanne ke liye software ka behavior (woh kaise chal raha hai) dekha jata hai aur masle ki jarr (source) dhoondi jati hai. Pehchanne ke baad bug hal karne ke liye code mein tabdeeli kar ke ghalti theek ki jati hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Debugging ka naam 1947 ke ek incident (waqiye) se para, jab ek computer ke andar sach much ka keera (bug), ek patanga (moth), mila tha!
Tools aur achhe tareeqe (Tools and Best Practices)
Debugging ke liye kai tools aur achhe tareeqe hain, jaise:

items: Debuggers: software tools jo programmers ko code step by step chalane, variables ki values dekhne aur program ke chalne par nazar rakhne de kar bugs dhoondne mein madad dete hain.
Print Statements: code mein print statements daalna ta ke program ki mukhtalif jagahon par variables ki values screen par nazar aayein.
Code Reviews: doosre developers se apna code check karwana ta ke mumkina ghaltiyan pakri jayein.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Print statement ki misal (Python): agar kisi variable ki value ghalat aa rahi ho to program ke beech mein print() laga kar dekha jata hai ke us waqt value kya hai.

total = 0
for n in [4, 5, 6]:
    total = total + n
    print("n =", n, "total =", total)
print("Final total:", total)
blocks.caption: Print statements se har step par values dekhna

blocks.text:
n = 4 total = 4
n = 5 total = 9
n = 6 total = 15
Final total: 15
blocks.caption: Output

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"total = 0": jama (sum) rakhne ke liye ek variable, shuru mein zero.
"for n in [4, 5, 6]:": loop (baar baar chalne wala hissa) list ke har number ko baari baari n mein rakhta hai: pehle 4, phir 5, phir 6.
"total = total + n": har chakkar mein purane total mein naya number jor diya jata hai.
"print("n =", n, "total =", total)": yeh debugging wali line hai; har step par n aur total ki value screen par dikhati hai, taa ke pata chale program andar kya kar raha hai.
"print("Final total:", total)": yeh line loop ke bahar hai (indentation nahi), is liye sirf aakhir mein ek baar chalti hai.
Output: "n = 4 total = 4", "n = 5 total = 9", "n = 6 total = 15" aur aakhir mein "Final total: 15", bilkul neeche wale Output box jaisa.
Khud try karein: list ko [4, 5, 6, 10] kar ke Run karein: ek nayi line "n = 10 total = 25" aayegi aur "Final total: 25".

Yeh program ek bug aur us ka fix dikhata hai: bug wala hissa marks ka jama hamesha 2 se taqseem (divide) karta hai, jab ke fix marks ki asal ginti se. marks ki list mein number badlein ya ek aur number jorein, Run karein aur dekhein ke bug wala average kaise ghalat aata hai aur print() wali line bug pakarne mein kaise madad karti hai.

marks = [72, 85, 64]   # teen subjects ke marks

# Bug wala version: hamesha 2 se taqseem (divide) karta hai
wrong_average = sum(marks) / 2
# Debugging: print se values dekhein
print("sum =", sum(marks), "| marks ki ginti =", len(marks))
# Fix: jitne marks hain utni ginti se taqseem karein
right_average = sum(marks) / len(marks)

print("Bug wala average:", wrong_average)
print("Theek kiya hua average:", round(right_average, 2))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"marks = [72, 85, 64]": teen subjects ke marks ki list.
"wrong_average = sum(marks) / 2": yeh bug (ghalti) hai: sum() sab marks jama karta hai (221) magar taqseem hamesha 2 se ho rahi hai, jab ke marks 3 hain.
"print("sum =", sum(marks), "| marks ki ginti =", len(marks))": debugging ke liye print: jama aur len() se marks ki ginti (count) dikhata hai. Isi se pata chalta hai ke ginti 3 hai, 2 nahi.
"right_average = sum(marks) / len(marks)": fix (durusti): ab utni ginti se taqseem jitne marks list mein hain.
"round(right_average, 2)": jawab ko decimal ke baad 2 digits tak gol (round) karta hai.
Output: "sum = 221 | marks ki ginti = 3", phir "Bug wala average: 110.5" (221 / 2, jo 100 se bhi zyada hai, is liye saaf ghalat) aur "Theek kiya hua average: 73.67" (221 / 3).
Khud try karein: list ko [72, 85, 64, 90] kar ke Run karein: ginti 4 ho jayegi, bug wala average 155.5 aur theek average 77.75 aayega.
